parameters.query:
SELECT
    p.id,
    p.name AS referencia,
    p.title AS titulo,
    p.price AS precio,
    p.area AS metros_cuadrados,
    p.bedrooms AS habitaciones,
    p.bathrooms AS banos,
    p.parking_spaces AS parqueaderos,
    p.street AS direccion_zona,
    p.city AS ciudad,
    COALESCE(t.name, 'Propiedad') AS tipo_propiedad,
    CASE p.offer_type WHEN 'sale' THEN 'Venta' ELSE 'Arriendo' END AS oferta,
    CASE WHEN p.wp_post_id IS NOT NULL AND p.wp_post_id > 0 THEN 'https://inmobi.com.ec/?p=' || p.wp_post_id ELSE NULL END AS link_propiedad,
    p.wp_post_id
FROM estate_property p
LEFT JOIN estate_property_type t ON p.property_type_id = t.id
WHERE p.state = 'available' AND p.active = true AND p.price > 0
  AND p.price <= ({{ $json.presupuesto_max || 999999999 }} * 1.15)
  -- OBLIGATORIO: "vip" o "credito vip" en titulo, descripcion o sector_keywords
  AND (
    lower(translate(coalesce(p.title,''),'áéíóúñÁÉÍÓÚÑ','aeiounAEIOUN')) ILIKE '%vip%'
    OR lower(translate(coalesce(p.title,''),'áéíóúñÁÉÍÓÚÑ','aeiounAEIOUN')) ILIKE '%credito vip%'
    OR lower(translate(COALESCE(p.description,''),'áéíóúñÁÉÍÓÚÑ','aeiounAEIOUN')) ILIKE '%vip%'
    OR lower(translate(COALESCE(p.description,''),'áéíóúñÁÉÍÓÚÑ','aeiounAEIOUN')) ILIKE '%credito vip%'
    OR lower(translate(COALESCE(p.sector_keywords,''),'áéíóúñÁÉÍÓÚÑ','aeiounAEIOUN')) ILIKE '%vip%'
  )
  -- Sector opcional (si se da, debe matchear al menos una palabra)
  AND (
    '{{ $json.ubicacion_norm || "" }}' = ''
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM unnest(string_to_array('{{ $json.ubicacion_norm }}', ' ')) AS word
      WHERE word != '' AND length(word) >= 3
        AND lower(translate(coalesce(p.title,'') || ' ' || coalesce(p.street,'') || ' ' || coalesce(p.city,'') || ' ' || COALESCE(p.sector_keywords,''),'áéíóúñÁÉÍÓÚÑ','aeiounAEIOUN')) ILIKE '%' || word || '%'
    )
  )
ORDER BY p.property_score DESC NULLS LAST, p.price ASC
LIMIT 8;
